scoring_contract.dependency_semantics: Requirements apply to individual cases and available observations, not full-score blocks. Primary-case credit is equal across eight; pair credit across two; halfstep credit across four. Missing-case accounting can be correct even when cases failed.

checks.criterion: Numeric identity of supplied coordinates, velocities, units and masses, including correct reversed state; no RNG-string scoring.
Native GPU4PySCF RKS/DFT/dispersion/integral settings and electronic-state evidence match the frozen model.
All required primary energies, analytic-gradient arrays and raw states are numerically consistent with native records and the frozen model, independently verified per trajectory.
Independent VV, time, gradient-norm and full-step-velocity recomputation passes; model/initial-state identity is preserved.

Verify pinned GPU4PySCF/VV setup and actual fresh primary propagation through every required time, retaining native SCF/gradient records for each distinct geometry. Check completeness per trajectory; an asserted success is insufficient.

blocks.title: Coordinate-derived primary labels and boundary margins

checks.criterion: Final distances and ordered classifier are recomputed correctly from complete native-backed primary states.
Active-boundary margins and numerical ambiguity are explicitly evaluated without changing the prescribed inequalities.
Correct two-component q, per-trajectory changes and condition means at every fixed time, retaining all three product directions.
Absolute TSre/TSsi contrast is quantitatively decomposed into initial geometry and subsequent motion with correct signs/units.

blocks.title: Two paired momentum interventions and measured effects

checks.criterion: Recompute the two complete counterfactuals and verify native state/energy/gradient consistency, identical starting geometry and kinetic energy, unchanged reactive kick and only reversed thermal momentum.
Correct matched pair q differences at 10/20 fs, no favorable endpoint/seed selection and no claim of ensemble product statistics.

Verify actual GPU4PySCF propagation of both predeclared counterfactuals through 20 fs from the designated initial states, with correct solver settings and native per-geometry receipts; not renamed primary outputs.

blocks.title: Four timestep controls and numerical resolvability analysis

checks.criterion: All four halfstep trajectories have numerically consistent native-backed energies/gradients and correct VV full-step states through 20 fs at the same fixed initial conditions.
Quantified two-sided pair sensitivity, certified-envelope comparison and justified resolved/unresolved effect semantics, without extending control coverage to 40/500 fs.

Verify actual execution of all four distinct 0.5 fs controls through 20 fs, with their native solver configuration and receipts; shared identical initial-state evaluations must be explicitly identified.
Correct kinetic/total energy and drift from matched full-step frames and native electronic energies, not potential-energy-only conservation.
Control energy/SCF evidence distinguishes timestep sensitivity from electronic failures and discloses unresolved drift.

blocks.title: Complete denominators, intervals and missing-case bounds

checks.criterion: Correct all-six-label counts, completed-only fractions and Wilson intervals including zero counts, excluding controls.
Truthful completed/failed accounting and full-four missing-case bounds; no missing values converted into favorable outcomes.

blocks.title: Paper-faithful conclusions tied to the computed experiment

checks.criterion: Mechanistic interpretation follows measured paired effects and controls rather than assuming the article's expected labels.
Distinguishes finite deterministic intervention, geometry diagnostics, original QCT preparation, orbital mechanisms and terminal population claims, with explicit remaining limitations.

scoring_contract.scoring_semantics: A=Structural Modeling 10%; B=Solver Config & Run Evidence Audit 10%; C=Result Analysis 80%. Research blocks are a reporting crosswalk, not an extra weighting level. Judging method is a separate axis.
